ALTERNATIVE METHODS
The City provides the following two alternative methods of viewing and listening to the City Council Meeting
convenience:

  ¡  On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video. Please check with your cable

  ¡  Live online through Facebook Live, with audio and limited video,

The disruption in service of any alternative method does not preclude the City Council or other legislative bod
from taking further action on an agenda item.

Submitting Comments Prior to Public Meeting: Members of the public may choose to submit comments
electronically for consideration by the City Council or other City Legislative Body by sending them to the City
Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To
ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, please submit
comments prior to 8:00 a.m. the day of the meeting, and in the body of the email, please identify the agenda
number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments
received after 8:00 a.m. and prior to the close of the public hearings will be made part of the official public rec
of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.

Inglewood, California
  September 12, 2023

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
September 12, 2023, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Mayor Butts called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour of 1:00 p.m.

The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Mayor Butts, Council Members Gray, Padilla, Morales, and Faulk;
  and
  Absent: None.

City officials and personnel present for closed session were as follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor Butts
inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address the City Council on the
Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1 and CS-2.

There was no response.

Mayor Butts recessed the City Council at the hour of 1:01 p.m. for Closed Session Item
Nos. CS-1 and CS-2.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the City
Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance
Authority, Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:01 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/Finance
Authority Secretary/Parking Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority Secretary
announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/ Parking Authority
  Chairman/ Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts,
  Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members/Finance Authority Members/Parking
  Authority Members/ Joint Powers Authority Members
  Gray, Padilla, Morales, and Faulk; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/ Joint
Powers Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/ Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Louis Atwell  Assistant City Manager/Public Works Director
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Finance Authority,
Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority.

PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Parking Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers
Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present who wished to address
the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Parking Authority/ Joint Powers
Authority on any item on the Agendas, other than the Public Hearing.
 September 12, 2023

  Speaker (Name Unknown) commented on Agenda Item Nos. DR-2, Approval of a Sewer
  Relocation Agreement with the County Sanitation District No. 2 of Los Angeles County
  (LACSD), DR-3, Approval of Amendment No. 2 to Agreement No. 22-118, and DR-4,
  Approval of Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 23-275 with Trifiletti Consulting, Inc.
  (TC).

  PRESENTATION – JEFF PRANG, LOS ANGELES COUNTY ASSESSOR. Coun
  ty  Assessor Jeff Prang presented a brief oral presentation regarding property assessments for
  the City of Inglewood. In his presentation, he reviewed the 2023 Assessment Roll, the
  Assessed Value Growth since 2010, the 2023 Median Sales Price (July 2023),
  Homeowners Exemptions, E-Notifications for Residents, and his contact information for
  additional comments or concerns.

142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member
  /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Morales, and seconded by
  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Faulk that the
